{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the interdisciplinary PhD program in physical activity, nutrition and wellness at Arizona State University. This is the only doctoral program in the country that enables researchers, scholars and leaders to meet the increasing demand for developing effective health promotion, physical activity and nutrition programs for all segments of society. Our students are prepared for careers in higher education, government agencies and health-related research positions in private industry.
The Program
The Physical Activity, Nutrition and Wellness PhD program is transdisciplinary — explicitly integrating exercise and nutrition research with scholarship on health promotion using a solutions-focused approach. Students tailor their course of study in one of two general areas: Nutrition and Health or Physical Activity and Health.
Admission Requirements
Applicants should have a master's degree prior to admission to the PhD program. In addition to meeting the requirements of Graduate Admission Services, admission to the PhD degree program is based on a number of factors that include GPA, GRE scores, letters of recommendation, statement of research interests and the availability of a mentor with matching interests.
Applications are accepted year-round. However, the priority application deadline is January 15 for admission to the fall semester of that year. There are no spring or summer admissions. Ready to apply? Click here.
